identity_evidence.identity_notes: Current AFD-derived cached taxonomy treats Manorina melanocephala leachi as an accepted subspecies within M. melanocephala, not a separate species. The existing historical-name bridge and original diagnostics therefore establish species identity, while the Tasmanian origin prevents describing this as a verified Sydney nominate form. The former hold combines a valid regional limitation with an unnecessarily strict requirement for species-level use. Accepting this historical representation does not assert that Tasmanian leachi is the local breeding form or a Sydney visitor. Retain a plain Tasmanian-form label. If the library later promises subspecies-accurate local plumage, use a separately verified mainland alternative then.

The image, detailed diagnosis and eastern distribution independently support species identity.
